rubric_verdicts.contrast: Pass. All text is near-black on white; the compile blue #3b6ea5 is 5.3:1 against white and the solve amber #b8791a is 3.6:1, both above the 3:1 floor for graphical marks, and the two hues are far apart for colour-blind readers.
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: Pass. Every mark encodes a measured value (four cold-compile bars, twelve solve points, four median rules); the bar fill is one flat colour with no gradient, and the image carries no ink that is not data, axis, legend or label.
rubric_verdicts.decoration: Pass. No gridlines, no background fill, no shading and no frame beyond the left and bottom spines; the legend is frameless and sits in clear space above the plot area.
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: Pass. Measured on the rendered PNG: the four x-tick labels occupy separate column runs with minimum inter-label gaps of 84, 48 and 106 px, nothing is clipped (ink spans x 20-1379 of 1400 and y 17-697 of 720), and no label sits over the plotted data.
rubric_verdicts.legibility: Pass. At 1400x720 the four arm labels and the three legend entries read without magnification; the y axis is titled 'wall [s]' with ticks at 0,20,40,60,80,100, and each arm shows its blue cold-compile bar and three amber solve points distinctly.
rubric_verdicts.table_form: Pass. The figure's job is the overlap of the three-pass solve ranges across arms, which a 4x4 table of numbers would not show at a glance; the bars and points are the right form and the underlying numbers are already tabulated in the page.
